task_message:
Case L28: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 251x251x341 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case L28 is complete. 

**Summary:** I segmented the large lipomatous soft-tissue tumor of the thigh on the T2-weighted fat-suppressed MRI (251×251×341, 1 mm isotropic).

- **Workflow:** `seg_open` overview → axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets to localize the lesion (a large, lobulated hyperintense mass in the anterior/anteromedial thigh compartment, spanning ~axial 120–260) → two positive seed points in the tumor core → `seg_refine` to tidy the boundary → accepted automatic candidate C1, which added the missed less-intense peripheral rim (a few mm thick around the bright core) → rejected vessel/edema-like linear candidates.
- **Verification:** Checked superior, mid and inferior slices in all three planes, plus the just-past-the-end panels from the final review (no lesion tissue beyond either end, no stray components, single connected component).
- **Result:** Final mask volume 757.2 mL, one component, retaining the contiguous fascial/tail extension inferiorly as instructed. Confidence: medium (heterogeneous periphery/edema at the inferior pole is the main uncertainty).
